description: Header file defining utility functions and wrappers for XNNPACK quantized convolution operations in PyTorch, including shape handling, weight conversion, and creation/setup of convolution and linear operators.

methods.name: get_mem_format_aware_shape
methods.description: Returns tensor shape respecting memory format (e.g., NHWC vs NCHW).

methods.name: q8_copy_int8_weight_and_add_offset
methods.description: Copies int8 weight tensor and adds offset, supporting different PT types.

methods.name: convert_conv_weights_to_channel_last_tensor
methods.description: Converts convolution weights to channel-last tensor format, supporting transposition.

methods.name: xnnp_create_convolution2d_nhwc
methods.description: Creates a 2D convolution operator with NHWC format, supporting transpose and per-channel options.

methods.name: xnnp_reshape_convolution2d_nhwc
methods.description: Reshapes convolution operator for given input dimensions, supporting transpose and per-channel.

methods.name: xnnp_setup_convolution2d_nhwc
methods.description: Sets up convolution operator with input and output tensors, supporting transpose and per-channel.

methods.name: xnnp_create_fully_connected_nc
methods.description: Creates a fully connected (linear) operator with quantized parameters.

methods.name: xnnp_reshape_fully_connected_nc
methods.description: Reshapes fully connected operator for batch size.

methods.name: xnnp_setup_fully_connected_nc
methods.description: Sets up fully connected operator with input and output tensors.
